findings.issue: Wrong phonetic romanization: the は of こんにちは is pronounced 'wa' (fossilized topic particle; the item's own expl says so). 'konnichiha' teaches a wrong pronunciation of the most basic greeting; standard Hepburn is 'konnichiwa'.

Sense-changing mis-literal: いいなあ = adjective いい 'good/nice' + emotive なあ (as the expl correctly states). 'Well, hmm...' renders it as hesitation fillers, contradicting the expl and the actual meaning ('how nice / lucky you').

でございます is 丁寧語 (polite/formal copula), not humble (謙譲語) — here it does not lower the speaker at all. Also inconsistent with expl_pt, which correctly says only 'forma extra-polida' with no humble claim.
findings.current: The target でございます is the extra-polite (humble) form of です/だ ('to be')
findings.suggested: The target でございます is the extra-polite (formal) form of です/だ ('to be')

findings.issue: Field is defined as phonetic and the project convention writes particle-derived は as わ (cf. わたしわ); the greeting is pronounced こんにちわ, so the phonetic transcription should use わ for consistency with the romaji fix.
Typo/garbled wording: missing space and confusing mash 'Bom dia(de tarde)'. こんにちは as a daytime greeting is 'Boa tarde' in Portuguese; lit_en correctly has 'Good afternoon! / Hello!'.
'reputação' is a mistranslation of 'hearsay' (expl_en says 'citation/hearsay'); 'reputação informal' does not convey the hearsay function of って and diverges from the EN version.
findings.current: O segundo って é o って de citação/reputação informal (= ということは)
findings.suggested: O segundo って é o って de citação/boato ('dizem que') (= ということは)

findings.issue: Parenthetical repeats the wrong keigo label: でございます is super-polite (丁寧語), not humble.
findings.current: As for this, what is it (humble-polite form)?
findings.suggested: As for this, what is it (super-polite form)?

findings.issue: Parenthetical repeats the wrong keigo label: でございます is extra-polido (丁寧語), not humilde; expl_pt itself says 'extra-polida'.
findings.current: Quanto a isto, o que é (forma humilde-polida)?
findings.suggested: Quanto a isto, o que é (forma extra-polida)?

findings.issue: Literal mirror inaccurate: それ = 'that' (not 'this'), and the で ('with that') is dropped, while lit_pt correctly mirrors it ('Com isso').
